semiconductor_relevance: High — EQ Global specializes in repair and refurbishment services for semiconductor equipment, particularly RF generators and related technologies.
summary: EQ Global is a leading provider of repair and refurbishment services for semiconductor equipment, focusing on RF generators, RF matchers, and plasma sources. With a commitment to maximizing customer uptime and cost efficiency, they offer advanced technical solutions and support to global clients.
capabilities: Repair and refurbishment of RF generators
Repair services for RF matchers and plasma sources
Customized engineering solutions for semiconductor equipment

regional_presence.Korea: EQ Global is headquartered in Korea and is recognized as a top semiconductor equipment repair company in the region.
regional_presence.China: The company has established a local subsidiary in Wuxi, China to support global customers.
regional_presence.Singapore: EQ Global has a presence in Singapore to enhance its service capabilities in the region.
